reason: No auto-charge on the trial is nice, so I'd actually start the 14 days without worrying about forgetting to cancel. But on $9,000 a year, even 3,250 won a month for something YouTube sleep music already does for free is hard to justify, so I'd most likely stop at the free version.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and already works well enough for me, and I don't trust that a phone on the bed can really tell when I fell asleep well enough to show a real difference.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fall asleep 15+ minutes faster with it, and there was a student discount around 1,500-2,000 won a month.
